notes.title: 2025-04-29 Update Notes
notes.content: By default, the game's map selection is changed to the official map, not a random map.

notes.title: 2024-06-10 Update Notes (Random Map)
notes.content:
1. Solve the problem that adding players will exceed the maximum number of players
2. Add random map function

notes.title: 2024-05-04 Update Notes
notes.content:
【Bug Fixes】
1. Fixed the bug that the attack range was displayed as a remnant
【What's New】
1. After clicking on the unit, the unit information in the lower right corner will be locked
2. New: You can click on the enemy unit to display the movement range and attack range of the enemy unit

notes.title: 2024-04-21 Update Notes
notes.content:
Balance Adjustments:
1. The initial bankroll for all players is reduced by 1000
2. The repairer was changed to a T1 unit
3. Repair helicopters changed to T2 units
Feature Updates:
1. Remove the original unit panel in the lower right corner
2. Added the function that when the mouse is moved over the terrain and units, the lower right corner will display the brief information.

notes.title: 2024-4-14 Update Notes
notes.content:
1. The unit selection interface adds a random selection function, which allows the system to randomly assign units
2. Optimize the unit arrangement of the unit list
3. Optimize the layout of some UI interfaces
4. Cancel the forced pop-up of the information pop-up box, and add the "About the game" button.

notes.title: 2024-04-13Update Notes
notes.content: 1. Added the unit introduction function on the unit selection page

notes.title: 2024-03-22Update Notes (New Unit!)
notes.content:
1. Added a new unit: Prism Tank
Unit Introduction:The more prism tanks around, the more powerful the lasers fired.

notes.title: 2024-03-10Update Notes (Workshop Officially Launched!) ）
notes.content:
1. Fixed an issue where workshop items could not be uploaded.
At this point, the Workshop is officially opened! Players can upload their own maps in the game, and if it says that the upload failed, please try a few more times!

notes.title: 2024-02-19Update Notes
notes.content: 1. Added the Workshop feature (beta version), you can now upload maps to the Workshop.

notes.title: 2024-02-17Update Note 2
notes.content: 1. Fixed an issue where the Nuke Achievement could not be achieved

notes.title: 2024-02-17Update Notes
notes.content: 1. Temporarily hide the Workshop button, the Workshop function has not yet been completed.

notes.title: 2024-02-15Update Note 2
notes.content:
1. Balance Modification: Units can no longer use skills after being frozen
2. Fixed the issue that the battle mech would report an error after jumping into an open space
3. Fixed the issue that the battle mech jumped to the position where the building could be placed

notes.title: 2024-02-15 Update Notes
notes.content:
1. After using the Furious Bomber's skill, it can no longer move.
2. Fixed the issue that the skill UI did not disappear after the self-destruct truck used the self-detonation skill
3. Fixed the issue that after the battle mech stepped on the self-exploding truck with the jumping skill, the game got stuck and could no longer control the unit.

notes.title: 2024-02-14Update Notes
notes.content:
1. Fixed the issue that undeveloped units would appear in the game editor
2. For design reasons, hide the skills of reconnaissance aircraft and rocket launchers
3. Fixed the issue that some unit skills can be used an unlimited number of times in a turn
4. Fixed an error issue after the end of the battle between two human players

notes.title: 2024-02-10Update Notes
notes.content: Added language setting options for Chinese Traditional and Japanese

notes.title: English language update
notes.content: We've added support for English, and in the coming days, we'll be adding other languages.

notes.title: Important minor updates
notes.content:
1. The resolution problem has been fixed.

2. Add the function of changing the game speed. You can choose 1, 2 or 4 times

3. Add the "eraser" function in the game editor to erase units.

4. The rocket launcher can be built in the game. The rocket launcher has the skill: scattering rocket.
